presentation.label: QPERF
presentation.summary: Set performance locks by holding QPER and turning knobs, clear them, or apply them to the kit.
presentation.overview: Hold QPER and turn a knob: it edits that parameter's offset in the performance linked to QPER, and the knob inverts and shows it as it does for a held performance pad. QPER + PLAY clears it and PLAY again undoes that. QPER + RECORD and STOP copy and paste it. QPER + YES writes what you hear into the kit and removes those locks.
highlights: Sets a lock in the linked performance with one turn
QPER + PLAY clears the linked performance
QPER + YES moves them into the kit
usage: Link a performance with QPER + a pad, hold QPER and turn knobs to shape one macro on the QPER knob.
Sweep the QPER knob, then QPER + YES when a sound is worth keeping.

access.location: The QPER key, on any page.
steps: Hold QPER and press pads to link performances, as on stock.
Keep QPER held and turn a knob to set its offset.
QPER + PLAY clears the linked performance; press PLAY again to undo. QPER + RECORD copies it, QPER + STOP pastes.
QPER + YES moves them into the kit.

limitations: QPER links one performance at a time, unlike stock.
Until the QPER knob moves after power on, QPER + YES uses the amounts stock holds.
Replaces stock's QPER + PLAY, which starts the sequencer.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

tests.summary: Emulator only, not tested on hardware.
